disambiguation: Not a data editor; it is a read-only client that renders structured data from Work Ledger into Obsidian views.
intentEvidence: See agent-assisted work clearly—projects, knowledge, evidence, and weekly reports—in the Obsidian Vault you already use.
motivation: To make agent-assisted work easier to understand by bringing structured data into the Obsidian Vault.
problem: Users managing agent-assisted projects in Work Ledger need a way to view structured data, projects, and reports within their existing Obsidian workspace.

relations.evidence: Agent Ledger reads through Work Ledger and never edits managed Markdown.

requires.name: The same absolute Vault in the CLI and Obsidian

summary: Agent Ledger provides read-only views of projects, tasks, knowledge, timelines, reports, and health data from Work Ledger within Obsidian.
